name: holdout_network
text: Reliable communication requires more than delivering bytes quickly. A sender needs to know whether data reached the receiver, and a receiver needs to identify missing or duplicated messages. Sequence numbers establish an ordering. A timeout can trigger retransmission when an acknowledgement does not arrive. Choosing a very short timeout increases unnecessary retries, while a very long timeout increases the delay after a real failure. Congestion control adjusts the rate at which new traffic enters the network. It responds to changing conditions rather than assuming that every path has a fixed capacity. Measurements from one connection may not describe another connection that follows a different route.

name: holdout_biology
text: Cells use membranes to separate internal processes from the surrounding environment. Proteins embedded in a membrane can move particular molecules across it. Some transport mechanisms use an existing concentration gradient, while others require energy. The behavior of a biological system depends on interactions between many components. Changing one component can alter several processes at once. For that reason, a controlled experiment compares groups that differ in a clearly specified condition. Researchers also need to check whether the measurement itself disturbs the system. Repeating an experiment with another method can reveal an artifact that was invisible in the original procedure.

name: holdout_chinese
text: 公共交通线路的调整需要综合考虑居民出行、道路条件和车辆数量。调查人员可以记录不同时间段的客流，并分析乘客在哪些站点换乘。增加发车频率能够缩短等待时间，但也会增加运营成本。对于客流较少的时段，可以安排较小的车辆，或者把相邻线路的班次协调起来。实施新的方案后，还应持续观察实际效果，及时处理换乘不便和站点拥挤等问题。一次短期调查只能反映当时的情况，长期决策还需要考虑季节变化和城市发展的影响。

name: holdout_rust
holdout_arithmetic
text: A workshop produces eighteen parts each hour. After five hours it has produced ninety parts. Twelve parts fail inspection, leaving seventy-eight usable parts. If each package holds thirteen parts, the workshop can fill six packages. A second workshop produces twenty-four parts each hour and loses one quarter of its output during inspection. Its usable output is also eighteen parts per hour. Comparing production rates requires deciding whether the count includes rejected parts. The same principle applies to percentages: the denominator must be identified before a percentage can be interpreted correctly.

name: holdout_reasoning
text: Every approved proposal has a named reviewer. Some approved proposals also have a second reviewer. It follows that every proposal with a second reviewer is approved only if an additional rule establishes that relationship. The original statements alone do not establish it. Necessary conditions and sufficient conditions are different logical relationships. If an event requires a valid ticket, possessing a ticket may still be insufficient when the venue is closed. A sound argument makes all relevant assumptions explicit. An example can illustrate a claim, but several examples cannot prove that the claim holds in every possible case.
